result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: overlapping/garbled metadata text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing. Everything else (carousels, chips, partially visible bottom card) appears intentional.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows two text strings rendered on top of each other ('25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' overlap, producing unreadable text like '25-3E0rdmivery • Ramen').
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine tags are laid out sequentially (e.g., in a horizontal flex row with separators) instead of being absolutely positioned or stacked at the same coordinates.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a '€0 delivery' badge on the image, and the same fee appears (though overlapped) in the metadata line, creating redundant/conflicting presentation once the overlap is fixed.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee in only one place per card, or ensure the badge and metadata line don't duplicate the same information.
